brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ, landscape 16:9, ideally 1792x1008 or another native approximately 16:9 PNG over 1000 px wide.

Visual language: approved editorial sports poster style, deep near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B dry-brush swath, warm ivory bold Japanese typography, a hand-drawn ink illustration with expressive crosshatching and rough brush marks. Minimal, confident, highly legible at small thumbnail size. Flat graphic illustration, never photographic. Do not use any team/league logo, sponsor, brand mark, or photograph.

Subject: exactly ONE REAL basketball player, Mark Smith (マーク・スミス), the Akita player. His likeness must follow his official Akita Northern Happinets portrait, visually checked for this task: short dense black tight curls with low rounded top and trimmed sides, broad near-straight dark eyebrows, brown almond-shaped eyes, medium-long straight nose, broad oval/squared face, full lips, very light short moustache and small chin stubble (NOT a full beard), medium-brown skin, muscular broad shoulders and athletic guard build. Do not draw a generic invented athlete. Do not draw Jarrett Culver from the previous approved style example.
Pose: powerful low driving dribble in three-quarter view on the RIGHT 43% of the frame, chest leaning forward, knees flexing, head raised looking toward the left. Show head through upper thighs, both complete arms and natural hands. His right hand controls one complete orange basketball near his hip on the viewer's right, the other hand balanced forward. Strong sweeping diagonal movement and a small lime motion brush behind him. Face is clearly visible with enough ivory midtones, not crushed black. All fingers anatomically plausible, exactly two arms. Hands, head and ball comfortably within the canvas. Plain ivory/black sleeveless uniform with a very small muted pink trim, NO logos, NO sponsor writing, NO name, NO jersey number. It is a conceptual basketball-action illustration, NOT a reconstruction of any actual game moment.

Layout: left roughly 56% dedicated to text, right to the player; text never overlaps his face, hands or ball. Large type with generous negative space. Header near top-left. Two massive headline lines in the upper-middle left. Smaller scope line beneath. Pending-information note set in clearly readable medium-small ivory type near lower-left. Footer labels left-aligned along bottom. Safe margins at least 5% around all text; all glyphs fully within frame. Keep very little texture behind text.

Render ONLY the following exact text, with accurate Japanese glyphs:
Small header: 「バスケまとめ」
Date next to or below header: 「2026.10.30」
Main headline line 1, massive ivory: 「試合結果」
Main headline line 2, massive lime: 「当日のEFF」
Supporting line, medium ivory: 「リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3」
Important note, legible: 「B.ONE：公式ポジション確認待ち」
Footer label 1: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Footer label 2: 「イメージ」

Editorial constraints: this article reports multiple October 30 games and league/registered-position daily EFF lists. There is no single main player, so Mark Smith was randomly selected from the names in the supplied manuscript only as the illustrative subject. Do not print his name, scores, statistics, rank, club name, performance claim, participation claim, victory claim or a game matchup anywhere. Preserve the B.ONE pending official-position qualifier. Do not add a trophy, scoreboard, ranking medal, crowd or other people. Do not carry over any name, date, score or wording from earlier style-reference artworks. No extra text beyond the eight exact text lines above.

REVISION 1 (FINAL)
Edit the FIRST image, the existing black/lime バスケまとめ thumbnail, using the SECOND image ONLY as the facial likeness reference for the real basketball player Mark Smith. Produce one final approx 16:9 PNG over 1000px wide.

Keep all eight existing text lines EXACTLY unchanged, with the same readable typography, wording, color and hierarchy. Keep the black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B brush-ink style, same low driving-dribble concept, one player only, plain ivory/black uniform and small pink trim. Preserve the entire left text area and footers.

Make these targeted corrections:
1. Shrink the complete PLAYER-AND-BALL illustration as a single compositional unit by about 12%, then position it fully inside the right side. There must be a generous visible margin (at least 45 pixels at 1672px width) to the RIGHT of the WHOLE basketball and every fingertip, and at least 40 pixels ABOVE his hair. The entire orange ball must be visible. Both hands must be fully visible, with exactly five anatomically plausible fingers each, no clipped fingertips. Maintain only two arms. Cropping below the thighs is acceptable. Do not crop the head, arms, hands, or basketball. Do not overlap text.
2. Correct his head/face to the SECOND reference, the official Mark Smith portrait: shorter, closer, rounded tight black curls and modest top volume, trimmed sides, broad nearly straight dark eyebrows, medium-long straight nose, broad oval/squared lower face, full lips. He is almost clean-shaven: only very faint short moustache and faint chin stubble. REMOVE the first image's heavy dark moustache and pointed/full goatee. Preserve his medium-brown skin and muscular guard build. Translate the official face into the SAME expressive hand-drawn ink/crosshatched illustration, not a photo or a pasted head. The actual portrait is identity reference only, never include it as a photo. No new generic fictional face.

Do not add any logos, sponsor lettering, player name, jersey number, individual statistic, score, matchup, trophy, medals, or new text. This is an illustrative imagined dribbling motion, not a recreation of an actual game.
